text: Your customers live just two streets away.
But their orders go to a warehouse 30 km away.
say: But their orders go to a warehouse thirty kilometres away.

asr: Pawan Setu builds the bridge back.

text: A neighbour orders on her phone.
Your shop packs it, right off your shelf.
A local rider brings it home in minutes.
Then the next order. And the next.
Every shop on the street, online.

say: Pawan Setu. Your shop, your neighbourhood.
